title: Commuting alpha and beta squares for an injective resolution lift
statement: For a scheme X, any family U of opens, a morphism of modules F to G and any cochain map between injective resolutions lifting it, the induced map of total Cech complexes commutes with the global-sections restriction alpha and with the augmentation beta. No cover hypothesis is required. The induced map is total.map of the termwise Cech functor applied to the lift. The maps and complexes are those of [def-sc-module-cech-comparison].

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma Tag 01EQ (cohomology-lemma-cech-cohomology) and its proof: the transformation of functors $\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,-)\to R\Gamma(U,-)$ on Mod(O_X) built from the double complex $\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,\mathcal I^\bullet)$

proof.text: In degree n alpha lands in the (n,0) summand. The total-map coprojection formula reduces its square to the naturality of moduleCechZero: restrictions of sections commute with module morphisms, including the natural scalar restriction identity at the whole open. Beta lands in the (0,n) summand; the same coprojection formula and functoriality reduce its square to the given degree-zero augmentation equation. Equality of cochain maps follows componentwise. The empty family gives the unique maps into empty products; degree zero uses the same formulas. The Cech functor used here is Mathlib CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor on opens, already present in the comparison definition, not the separately constructed SiteCechComplex for general sites.

theorem moduleCechLiftSquares {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    {F G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution G) (ψ : I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex)
    (hψ : I.ι.f 0 ≫ ψ.f 0 = φ ≫ J.ι.f 0) :
    let T := HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op ⋙
          CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) |>.map ψ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    moduleCechAlpha U I ≫ T =
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map ψ ≫ moduleCechAlpha U J ∧
    moduleCechBeta U I ≫ T =
      (CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
          φ.val) ≫ moduleCechBeta U J
